ne13dbf3ccc.headline: Sentiment Lifts, Conviction Lags
ne13dbf3ccc.summary: US equities rebounded on Tuesday after an early dip, with the S&P 500 finding support near its 100-day moving average. Some software firms reported earnings early to ease AI concerns.
ne13dbf3ccc.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark index for large US companies and a key gauge of broad US equity sentiment. Software stocks are sensitive to fears that AI could erode their revenue.

impacts.name: Nasdaq 100
impacts.why: The tech-heavy index rebounded after briefly dipping below 24,400.

n33a7af3391.headline: Cryptos Trade In The Green Ahead Of FOMC Minutes
n33a7af3391.summary: Cryptocurrency markets traded mildly positive as investors awaited the release of the recent FOMC minutes. The Federal Reserve minutes are closely watched for signals on interest rates.
n33a7af3391.why: FOMC minutes summarise the US Federal Reserve's policy deliberations, which influence interest rates and risk appetite. Crypto assets often react to shifts in global liquidity expectations.

n32fda55d49.headline: MTN shifts strategy with R35bn IHS acquisition
n32fda55d49.summary: MTN is shifting strategy with a R35 billion acquisition of IHS. Analysts say the move makes strategic sense because currency devaluations have pushed lease costs higher.
n32fda55d49.why: MTN Group is a major African mobile operator, and tower companies like IHS own the infrastructure that carries its network. Acquisitions of this kind change cost structures and capital allocation for telecom groups.

n6d94fe0eb5.headline: Monte dei Paschi board greenlights Mediobanca merger and delisting plan
n6d94fe0eb5.summary: Monte dei Paschi's board approved a plan to merge with Mediobanca and delist the target. The bank acquired an over 86% stake in Mediobanca last September.
n6d94fe0eb5.why: Monte dei Paschi is an Italian bank and Mediobanca is a major Italian investment bank, so the merger reshapes the domestic banking sector. Delisting removes the target from public markets.

n9bd272b631.headline: Nyerges & Partners Advises Eximprod on Selling an Operational 6.4 MW Solar Photovoltaic Project to AJ Brand
n9bd272b631.summary: Nyerges & Partners advised Eximprod on selling the operational 6.4 MW Gebeleizis solar photovoltaic project to AJ Brand. The project received funding under the National Recovery and Resilience Plan.
n9bd272b631.why: Operational solar assets are traded between developers and investors as a way to recycle capital. Projects backed by EU recovery funds are a notable part of Central European renewable deal flow.

n3466904960.headline: Praktiker Hellas Growth Strategy After Paval Deal
n3466904960.summary: Praktiker Hellas has launched a growth plan following its acquisition by Paval Holding, focusing on capital, digital transformation, real estate and people.
n3466904960.why: Praktiker is a Greek home improvement retailer, and a change of owner typically brings new capital and strategy decisions.

n37cd1f8979.headline: Clean Monday Food Prices Rise Up to 30%
n37cd1f8979.summary: Seafood, lagana, taramasalata and other traditional Clean Monday foods are significantly more expensive this year, up to 30% above 2025 levels.
n37cd1f8979.why: Food price inflation feeds into consumer price indices and household spending power.

nfb3b5be064.headline: Qatar CPI rises 2.28% YoY in January 2026
nfb3b5be064.summary: Qatar's consumer price index recorded 109.90 points in January 2026, down 2.22% from December 2025, while the year-on-year rise was 2.28%.
nfb3b5be064.why: Consumer price data guides central bank policy expectations and the real income outlook for Qatar's economy.

na5c6326ac4.headline: Alcoa to pay $39 million after illegally clearing Australian native forest
na5c6326ac4.summary: Alcoa will pay A$55 million ($38.9 million) to remediate native forest it illegally cleared in Western Australia to mine bauxite, Australia's environment ministry said.
na5c6326ac4.why: Alcoa is a major US aluminium producer, and environmental penalties and remediation costs affect its operating expenses.

n7f2c465fae.headline: Russia-Ukraine Peace Talks Cut Short in Geneva
n7f2c465fae.summary: Russia-Ukraine peace talks in Geneva were cut short, with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky accusing Moscow of stalling negotiations.
n7f2c465fae.why: Progress or breakdown in Russia-Ukraine talks affects energy, grain and sanctions expectations and European risk sentiment.
n7f2c465fae.why_moved: The talks ended early with Zelensky accusing Moscow of stalling, which points to lower near-term prospects for a deal.

nb4b362c397.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Up 0.95% Amid EU Market Gains
nb4b362c397.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange opened 0.95% higher on February 18, 2026, as the STOXX 600 rose 0.74% and the IBEX 35 gained 1.13%.
nb4b362c397.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its moves track broader European risk sentiment.

n6416be8da9.headline: New Zealand Dollar Weakens After Central Bank Decision
n6416be8da9.summary: The New Zealand dollar weakened after the Reserve Bank of New Zealand kept interest rates unchanged. The decision was announced on the day of the report.
n6416be8da9.why: The RBNZ sets New Zealand's official cash rate, which shapes the currency, borrowing costs and inflation outlook.

impacts.name: New Zealand dollar
impacts.why: A hold on rates can reduce the currency's yield appeal relative to peers, pressuring the currency.

ndcbfc078b3.summary: The Monte dei Paschi board unanimously approved the pathway to integration with Mediobanca, in line with the offer outlined a year ago. Mediobanca will leave the stock exchange as part of the process.
ndcbfc078b3.why: Monte dei Paschi is an Italian bank based in Siena, and Mediobanca is a Milan investment bank; a combination would reshape Italian banking consolidation.

nec46a63d16.headline: Adanis APSEZ, French port Marseille Fos  sign pact to boost IMEC trade connectivity
nec46a63d16.summary: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone signed a memorandum of understanding with the Port of Marseille Fos. The pact covers trade facilitation, port innovation and energy transition along the India-Middle East-Europe corridor.
nec46a63d16.why: Adani Ports is India's largest private port operator and a key player in trade logistics. Partnerships like this shape cargo flows on India-Europe routes.

entities.name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone

ned79abe0d1.headline: Alcoa To Modernize Australia Mining Approvals; Take $19 Mln Q4 Charge
ned79abe0d1.summary: Alcoa's Australian unit has agreed with the Australian Federal Government to modernise the approvals framework for its Western Australian mining operations. The company will take a $19 million fourth-quarter charge.
ned79abe0d1.why: Alcoa is a major global producer of bauxite, alumina and aluminium, and its Western Australian operations are a key part of that supply chain. Approval timelines affect its costs and output.

n9b6b8c1c5e.headline: Trump launches his ‘Board of Peace’ with billions pledged for Gaza, but many allies are wary
n9b6b8c1c5e.summary: Trump is set to convene the inaugural Board of Peace meeting, with billions pledged for Gaza. Representatives from Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Hungary and Belarus are expected to attend.
n9b6b8c1c5e.why: Reconstruction pledges for Gaza shape the flow of reconstruction spending and Gulf investment in the region. Political backing from major regional states affects the outlook for funding.

n169cc87b17.headline: Wall St ends higher, lifted by Nvidia, other AI stocks
n169cc87b17.summary: US stocks finished higher as nerves around AI eased, lifting Nvidia, Amazon and other technology heavyweights.
n169cc87b17.why: The S&P 500 is a benchmark index of large US companies, and AI-linked technology stocks carry significant index weight.

impacts.name: NVIDIA
impacts.why: Nvidia shares rose in the session as AI nerves dissipated.

ne6a26f0cf0.headline: Private health insurance hike another blow for budgets
ne6a26f0cf0.summary: The Australian health minister has approved a large private health insurance premium increase. Households under budget pressure are likely to downgrade cover rather than drop it, according to the source.
ne6a26f0cf0.why: Private health insurance premiums are set through government approval, and changes affect household budgets and insurers' membership and revenue.

n1c0c4d5ea3.headline: Orthocell receives $3 million R&D tax refund, lifting cash to $49.6 million
n1c0c4d5ea3.summary: Orthocell confirmed it received a $3.0 million refund under the Australian Federal Government's Research and Development tax incentive, lifting its cash balance to $49.6 million.
n1c0c4d5ea3.why: Orthocell is an ASX-listed medical device company, and cash balances and government incentives are key to funding its development.

nad141f0c79.headline: European Central Bank chief to exit before term's end
nad141f0c79.summary: ECB President Christine Lagarde reportedly wants to leave her post early to help France and Germany's leaders, according to reports.
nad141f0c79.why: The European Central Bank sets monetary policy for the euro area, so leadership changes can shape rate decisions and euro expectations.

nf46e047cae.headline: Japan's exports surge 17% in January, on strong shipments to China and other Asian markets
nf46e047cae.summary: Japan's exports jumped nearly 17% in January from a year earlier. The gain was driven by strong shipments to China and other Asian markets.
nf46e047cae.why: Japan's export data is a key read on global trade demand and the health of its manufacturing-heavy economy.

n2814a9a768.headline: Inflation does a job on wage growth, adds heat to rates
n2814a9a768.summary: Rising inflation has pushed real wages below the level of rising costs. The report says this could have a significant impact on interest rate expectations.
n2814a9a768.why: Real wage trends influence household spending and the inflation outlook, which central banks weigh when setting interest rates.

nc29cb4360d.headline: Nvidia leads the US stock market higher
nc29cb4360d.summary: The US stock market ticked higher, led by Nvidia, its most influential stock. No further details on index levels were given.
nc29cb4360d.why: US equity indexes are heavily weighted toward large technology stocks, so moves in Nvidia can influence broad market performance.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia's gain led the broader market move.

n9a99c8a0e4.headline: Indonesia coal plant closure U-turn sows energy transition doubts
n9a99c8a0e4.summary: Indonesia has reversed a planned coal plant closure, raising doubts about its energy transition. Residents near Cirebon-1 describe increased respiratory problems since operations began.
n9a99c8a0e4.why: Indonesia is a major coal producer and exporter, and its power policy shapes coal demand and its climate commitments.

n66d9dfcd45.headline: i-Sens Soars 23% on EU CGM Expansion [K-bio pulse]
n66d9dfcd45.summary: Shares of South Korean medical device company i-Sens rose 23% on news of an expansion of its continuous glucose monitoring product in the EU.
n66d9dfcd45.why: i-Sens is a South Korean company that makes diabetes-related medical devices, so its EU sales expansion affects its revenue outlook.

n118c2f2a5e.headline: Japan Election Supermajority Boosts Market Confidence In Economic Recovery
n118c2f2a5e.summary: Conservatives secured a two-thirds parliamentary supermajority in Japan's election. Commentary frames it as a major turning point that boosts market confidence in economic recovery.
n118c2f2a5e.why: Japan's political stability and policy direction influence the yen, Japanese government bonds and the Nikkei 225, which are closely watched by global investors.
n118c2f2a5e.why_moved: The article says a two-thirds conservative supermajority boosts market confidence in Japan's economic recovery, reducing perceived political uncertainty.
